banner: PUBLIC dataset (ULB Credit Card Fraud, Dal Pozzolo et al. 2015, OpenML 1597). Card transactions with anonymised features, NOT ticket scalping; not TicketLedger data; a check of the fraud METHOD only; not evidence of real-world performance for TicketLedger.

source.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB, September 2013)
source.citation: Dal Pozzolo, A., Caelen, O., Johnson, R. A. & Bontempi, G. (2015). Calibrating Probability with Undersampling for Unbalanced Classification. IEEE Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Data Mining (CIDM).

split.method: chronological by Time: oldest 60% train, next 20% calibrate + threshold, newest 20% test

rule.rule: flag the largest amounts (>= 1127.95, top 1% of the calibration period)

note: Same method as the app's fraud model (chronological split, isotonic calibration on a later period, threshold fixed before the test at 1% false flags, comparison with a rule at a similar flag budget). Card fraud is not scalping: these numbers say the method works on real rare fraud, not that the TicketLedger model does.
